notes.note: Push-range and freshness rows now state the refuse-only-on-a-finding rule: each step warns when it cannot reach a verdict (no merge base, stale origin/main, oversize diff, crash, timeout); freshness refuses only a clean checkout of the pushed commit on a branch that records reviews; whitespace uses the pushed commit's attributes; entry points include workspace package.json entries. Checked against the two scripts, scripts/lib/prepush-base.mjs and scripts/lib/new-export-check.mjs.
